Package sootup.callgraph

Class LabeledGraphBasedCallGraph<L>

java.lang.Object
sootup.callgraph.GraphBasedCallGraph
sootup.callgraph.LabeledGraphBasedCallGraph<L>
Type Parameters:
L - the type of the labels attached to the calls
All Implemented Interfaces:
CallGraph, LabeledCallGraph<L>, MutableCallGraph, MutableLabeledCallGraph<L>
public class LabeledGraphBasedCallGraph<L> extends GraphBasedCallGraph implements MutableLabeledCallGraph<L>
This class implements a mutable call graph as a graph whose calls can carry labels of type L. The labels of a call keep their insertion order.

Call graph algorithms create a plain GraphBasedCallGraph. Use of(CallGraph) to label their result, or override AbstractCallGraphAlgorithm.initializeCallGraph(List, List) to return a labeled call graph that is filled during the construction.

GraphBasedCallGraph.diff(CallGraph) compares the calls only and ignores labels.
